items.title: GSK eyes future growth with cost-cutting plan amid promising Q2
items.summary: GSK will reallocate a large portion of the £1.9bn saved through to 2029 towards late-stage pipeline acceleration, primarily in oncology.

items.title: ADCs: How to manage complexities in growing supply chains
items.summary: With the rapid growth of the antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) a GlobalData webinar outlined how to address these issues in expanding supply chains.

items.title: From friction to compliance: Cultivating seamless operations in a shifting regulatory landscape
items.summary: Despite risks of noncompliance, a fragmented, legacy-based compliance approach still dominates life sciences.

items.title: FDA grants fast track designation for HAYA Therapeutics’ HTX-001
items.summary: HAYA Therapeutics has secured fast track designation from the US FDA for its investigational therapy, HTX-001, to treat symptomatic nHCM.

items.title: Eisai and CORE Biomedicine agree on global licence for oncology pipeline
items.summary: Eisai has entered an exclusive global licensing agreement with CORE Biomedicine for several preclinical oncology programmes.
